description: Establish the DRIVE design foundation: replace Wayfarer tokens/fonts in global src/styles.scss with DRIVE tokens + reusable helper classes (btn/badge/panel/field/label/section-*/icon-tile/logo-tile), and restyle the two shared single-file components (feedback-message, system-page) to DRIVE. This is the base every later feature depends on. Independent of FEAT-002/003/004 except that they consume these global classes, so it MUST land first.
steps: In src/styles.scss: replace the DM Sans @import with the Manrope Google Fonts @import (keep weights 400;500;600;700;800). Replace the Wayfarer :root custom properties with the DRIVE palette tokens listed in plan.md (blue-500 #3478f6, blue-600 #1f66e5, blue-700 #1854c4, slate-950 #101217, slate-50/100/200/400/500, ivory #f3f1ec, emerald-50/600/700, amber-50/600/700, blue-50, white). Set body background:#fff and color:var(--color-slate-950) and font-family to Manrope.

In src/styles.scss keep all existing global resets (* box-sizing), prefers-reduced-motion block, and ::selection (recolor to blue). Recolor the focus-visible outline to DRIVE blue (var(--color-blue-500)). Retune [data-theme='dark'] by overriding the same custom properties to a slate-950-based dark palette (dark bg, white ink, slate-800 borders).

In src/styles.scss add reusable helper classes per plan.md: .btn (base) + .btn-primary/.btn-secondary/.btn-ghost/.btn-dark; .badge + .badge-blue/.badge-green/.badge-amber/.badge-slate; .panel; .section-kicker; .section-title (with <=640px size tweak); .label; .field-label; .field (with :focus ring); .icon-tile; .logo-tile (+ inverse variant). Approximate the Figma Tailwind spacing/colors with equivalent CSS values.

In src/app/shared/components/feedback-message.component.ts edit ONLY the inline styles block: restyle .error to rose-50 bg/rose-700 text/rose-200 border, .success to emerald-50/emerald-700/emerald-200, .info to blue-50/blue-700/blue-200, with rounded-xl (~.75rem) radius and Manrope font-weight 600. Do NOT change the class, selector 'app-feedback-message', the message()/variant() inputs, or the template bindings ([class], [attr.role], @if guard).

In src/app/features/system/system-page.component.ts edit ONLY the inline template + styles: center the column, style the {{ code() }} label like a blue-600 uppercase section-kicker, the {{ title() }} heading as a black section-title, {{ message() }} as slate-500 muted text, and the routerLink="/dashboard" link as a primary button (keep the arrow span and the three input() bindings code/title/message).
acceptance_criteria: src/styles.scss imports Manrope (not DM Sans) and defines the DRIVE palette custom properties plus the .btn*/.badge*/.panel/.field/.label/.section-*/.icon-tile/.logo-tile helper classes.
feedback-message and system-page keep their exact selectors, input() APIs, and template bindings; only their inline styles/template markup changed.
npm run build succeeds with no SCSS error and no anyComponentStyle budget error.
npm test -- --watch=false passes all existing specs.
verification: Run 'npm install' in the worktree if node_modules is absent.
Run 'npm run build' and confirm it completes with no errors or budget failures.
Run 'npm test -- --watch=false' and confirm all specs pass.
findings:
DRIVE foundation landed in src/styles.scss. Later features should CONSUME these global helper classes (do not redefine them locally; the production anyComponentStyle 8kB budget forces shared primitives global). Exact class names/signatures:
- Buttons: `.btn` (base: inline-flex, height 3rem, radius .75rem, 700 14px, has `:disabled{opacity:.5}`) combined with ONE of `.btn-primary` (blue-600 bg, white, shadow var(--shadow-primary), hover blue-700), `.btn-secondary` (white bg, slate-950 text, slate-200 border, hover slate-400 border), `.btn-ghost` (transparent, #334155, hover slate-100 bg), `.btn-dark` (slate-950 bg, white, hover #1e293b). Use as `class="btn btn-primary"`. Hover rules are gated on `:not(:disabled)`.
- Badges: `.badge` (pill, 700 12px) + tone `.badge-blue` / `.badge-green` / `.badge-amber` / `.badge-slate`.
- `.panel`: radius 1rem, 1px slate-200 border, white bg, padding 1.5rem.
- `.section-kicker`: 800 12px uppercase, letter-spacing .18em, blue-600.
- `.section-title`: 900 1.875rem, letter-spacing -.02em, slate-950; drops to 1.75rem at <=640px.
- `.label`: 800 11px uppercase, letter-spacing .05em, slate-400.
- `.field-label`: block, 700 14px, #334155, margin-bottom 1.25rem.
- `.field`: full-width 3rem input, radius .75rem, slate-200 border, white bg; `:focus` -> blue-500 border + 4px rgba(52,120,246,.10) ring. Apply directly to <input>/<select>.
- `.icon-tile`: 2.75rem square, radius .75rem, blue-50 bg / blue-600 fg, grid place-items center.
- `.logo-tile`: 2.25rem square, radius .75rem, slate-950 bg / white fg; add `.logo-tile-inverse` for white bg / slate-950 fg.
Tokens on :root: --font-sans (Manrope); --color-blue-50/500/600/700/700-text; --color-slate-950/500/400/200/100/50; --color-ivory; --color-white; --color-emerald-50/600/700; --color-amber-50/600/700; --color-rose-50/200/700; --shadow-primary (0 10px 30px rgba(31,102,229,.2)). [data-theme='dark'] overrides the same vars (slate-950 surfaces, white ink, slate-800-ish borders).
Shared components restyled (APIs untouched): feedback-message (.error rose, .success emerald, .info blue, radius .75rem, weight 600) and system-page (centered column; code label as section-kicker; title uses `.section-title`; message slate-500; back link uses `btn btn-primary`). Verified: `npm run build` OK (styles.css 13.51 kB, no budget error), `npm test -- --watch=false` 11/11 pass.
ENV NOTE: node_modules had to be reinstalled clean (rm node_modules + package-lock) once to fix an npm optional-deps native-binding bug (rolldown) before vitest would run. Host Node is v25.2.1 (outside the engines range but builds/tests fine).
